content: Apple documentation requires checking capture authorization before setup, prompts for notDetermined, and directs later authorization changes through Settings. Capture sessions publish running and interruption state. Player end notifications identify the finished item, and interrupted seeks call completion with false. Project inference: bind UI and stale-feedback rejection to current session and current item, with explicit recovery controls. Sources: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfoundation/requesting-authorization-to-capture-and-save-media ; https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfoundation/avplayeritem/didplaytoendtimenotification ; https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfoundation/avplayeritem/seek(to:completionhandler:)-91gnw
